product.title: 6-Inch Car Polishing Pads, 5-Piece Foam Set – Hook-and-Loop Backing, Heavy to Light Cut for Waxing, Buffing, Scratch Removal, Auto Detailing, and Headlight Restoration – Fits Drill and DA Polishers
product.description: 5-piece foam pad set for scratch removal, polishing, and finishing. Heavy-cut pads (White/Orange), medium-cut (Yellow/Blue), and finishing (Black). Hex design reduces heat and improves compound spread. Strong hook-and-loop backing fits drills and DA polishers. Washable and reusable.
